{{Infobox auto|title=Prayer of St. Clement|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Prayer of St. Clement''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that gives [[Trailblaze]] III. It is crafted from a pair of leather boots, two wool of any color and two [[Obol]]s.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/traversal.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Prayer of St. Clement" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Prayer of St. Clement is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Trailblaze applies to boots and speeds the wearer up on paths, gravel, coarse dirt and mud bricks. Level III is the enchantment's normal maximum. The Prayer of Exodus [[Ofuda]] also gives Trailblaze III.

The book stores Trailblaze III directly, so applying it to boots that already have Trailblaze follows the normal combining rules and no longer goes past level III.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/traversal.json}}</ref>

== Trivia ==
* Saint Clement is traditionally the patron saint of hatters and felt makers; legend credits him with discovering felt by lining his sandals with wool, as the recipe lines boots with wool. The enchantment's internal id is still <code>traversal</code>.
